metadata.title: AI Products and Business Solutions
metadata.description: Explore Risein AI solutions including TaLi SmartBookkeeper, PersonaLab AI, business opportunity platforms and intelligent automation systems.

hero.title: Products and platforms built to solve real business and career problems.
hero.description: Our solutions turn practical ideas into working systems—from conversational bookkeeping and market validation to opportunities, communities and connected business platforms.

introduction.title: More than concepts. Practical systems designed for real users.
introduction.description: Each Risein AI solution begins with a clear problem and is developed around accessibility, practical value and measurable improvement.

stat1.label: Focused products that assist users with defined tasks.

stat2.label: Accessible experiences through tools people already understand.

stat3.label: Modular platforms designed for continued development.

tali.title: TaLi SmartBookkeeper
tali.subtitle: Bookkeeping and business management through conversation.
tali.description: TaLi turns WhatsApp and Telegram into an intelligent financial workspace for small businesses. Users can record sales, purchases, stock and debts in simple everyday language and receive organised business information in return.
tali.previewMessage: I sold five bags of rice for ₦180,000. The customer paid ₦120,000 and will pay the balance later.

transactions.title: Transaction recording
transactions.description: Record sales, purchases and expenses through natural conversation.

inventory.title: Inventory tracking
inventory.description: Monitor stock movements and receive warnings when items run low.

debts.title: Debt tracking
debts.description: Keep organised records of customers who still owe money.

reports.title: Business summaries
reports.description: Receive understandable financial and operational reports.

persona.title: PersonaLab AI
persona.subtitle: Test an idea against simulated customer perspectives.
persona.description: PersonaLab helps founders and teams examine how different customer groups may respond to a product, service, campaign or policy before investing heavily in development.
persona.previewTitle: What could different customers think about your idea?

personas.title: Diverse customer personas
personas.description: Review the idea from different demographic and behavioural perspectives.

validation.title: Concept validation
validation.description: Identify possible interest, objections and adoption barriers.

feedback.title: Structured feedback
feedback.description: Compare customer reactions instead of receiving one generic opinion.

recommendations.title: Practical recommendations
recommendations.description: Receive suggestions for positioning, pricing and product improvement.
